text: Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG) is a Tadawul-listed Saudi media group whose controlling ownership runs through state-linked financial institutions to the Public Investment Fund (PIF): press reports describe it as majority-owned by the Saudi government via two al-Ahli funds whose main investor is PIF.
short: Media researchers and press place the Saudi state behind SRMG's controlling ownership, via al-Ahli/SNB Capital funds tied to PIF.

source.name: State Media Monitor (Media and Journalism Research Center): Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG)
source.quote: It is a listed company, but its controlling ownership runs through state-linked financial institutions to the Public Investment Fund

additionalSources.name: TheWrap, via Yahoo: 'Why Does Jay Penske's Media Company Still Have a $200 Million Saudi Stake 9 Months After Khashoggi's Murder?'
additionalSources.quote: it is majority-owned by the Saudi government via two funds titled al-Ahli. The main investor in al-Ahli, according to its website, is the Saudi Public Investment fund.
